findings.finding: Counter-taxonomy imprecision: a recorded-digest belt mismatch increments corruption_rebuilds (prepared.py:843) rather than a refusal-class counter, though the generation is readable (nothing quarantined). Deliberate and fixture-pinned (PP05 expects exactly 2), but it slightly blurs designs/02's 'corruption rebuild vs refusal' distinction: unrepresentable-payload refusals land in tier2_refusals while digest-mismatch refusals land in corruption_rebuilds.
findings.requirement: either document the bucketing in the counters comment or split the counter in a later increment; do not re-pin existing fixtures silently

findings.finding: The residue-guard exemption (.una-batch-prepared in _PERSISTENT_STORES) means a misplaced or per-row-scattered prepared store root would no longer be caught by runtime_residue/hidden_residue; placement is now enforced only by fixture assertions (store_root endswith + singleflight_not_lost). The exemption itself is exact-name and justified (same persistent, identity-verified class as the cohort store), and row artifacts plus every other .una-batch* name still fatal.
findings.requirement: a future guard asserting at most one .una-batch-prepared root per run tree would restore the placement check; not required for this increment

findings.finding: Delta notation in prepared_source_commit.json ('prepared.py (+509/-...)') uses adds+removes totals: actual numstat is +478/-31 (total 509); Topology '+510' = +285/-225; runtime '+57' = +52/-5; worker '+36' is exact adds. Consistent convention, load-bearing line-count claim (929) exact - not materially false.

A row that fails validation inside the flight (e.g. Polygon network) holds the per-identity single-flight lock while failing; same-identity waiters serialize through re-election and each raises its own identical error. Per-row failure chronology is preserved (PP05 pins byte-identical messages); an all-invalid batch pays serialized build-to-failure time. Acceptable at increment C; P04 owns runtime admission.

'Refuse new leases during shutdown' (designs/02) has no enforcement because the runtime has no shutdown phase in which leases could be refused - vacuously satisfied today (workers die with the run). Forward obligation for P04; the deliverables already name P04 as the admission/teardown seam.

Run-tier snap decode rebuilds uid as a name-less pd.Series (prepared.py:781-783) while the B-tier preserves the original Series name; no consumer reads uid.name (repo grep: positional np.asarray/index access only) and the stage-cache restore does the same (Topology.py:577) - consistent with the established restore discipline.

Served rows carry one extra explicit log line ('... restored from prepared layer ...') absent from produced rows; same accepted discipline as the stage-cache restore marker ('observationally equivalent up to the explicit hit line', Topology.py:124-131).
